scope: Full native Sugarscape experimental design: sixteen ordered rule/learning pairings, fifty seeds, 20000 transitions under both released-code and manuscript-table parameter interpretations. Historical timing narrative is not a controlled benchmark.
qualifications: Released alpha0.9/gamma0.8 and paper alpha0.8/gamma0.9 both retained, without outcome-based selection.
Prospective seeds replace unavailable historical seeds; released five repetitions expanded to manuscript fifty.
Recorder measurement randomness corrected and qualified against native BehaviorSpace; original failure retained.
Figure calibration and panel-label corrections documented; unreadable and defective panels unresolved.
Historical plot sampling uncertainty and equivalence margins unavailable.
Nineteen endpoint targets overlap neither interpretation; twenty-seven unresolved.
Descriptive endpoint findings do not prove all-time dominance, equivalence, activation causality, or historical timing ratio.
Comparator path correction and exact-decimal independent verifier amendment preserve original scientific data and failures.
